About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining the Power System team and reporting to the Senior Electrical Engineer - Power Generation, this role covers Kainantu Gold Mine’s Permanent Power Station, Temporary Power Station, Kumian Camps Power Generation, 800L Portal Power Distribution Systems and associated controls, you will be responsible for the Production, Transformation & distribution of Power across the HV Network. This role, under the direction of the Senior Electrical Engineer, will contribute to the design, implementation, and management of power generation and transmission projects for Kainantu Gold Mine.
The Electrical Engineer shall provide engineering leadership to the Generation & Distribution Network and will assist the business to achieve project objectives and deliver on its Asset Management Policy. Additionally, the role supports the Asset Management team to deliver the best outcome for the range of developing and existing energy generation assets.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Ensure all statutory electrical inspections and works are carried out on plant site surface electrical equipment safely and within compliance with relevant laws, regulations and company standards.
Maintaining all electrical documentation and records. These include equipment specifications, data sheets, as build drawings, scope of works, change of management, and report writing.
Carry out engineering study, estimates, prepare technical drawings, P&IDs, E&I Schematics/SLDs, and specifications of electrical and control systems, procurement, and ensure installation conform to standards, project requirements, and safe operational requirements.
Communicates exceptionally within the team and in cross-functional work with other departmental sections and groups.
Assist with diagnosing electrical defects or hazards on systems, plant, and equipment, and identify adjustments, repair timely, and drive team to take key learnings.
Identify areas of sustainable improvement and drive to improve plant and equipment up time.
Assist with budgeting to meet plant and equipment operational requirements.
Perform reliability and maintenance of alarms, safety devices, and emergency electrical systems onsite.
Perform, enhance, and support the following functions as an Engineer:
Scoping, challenging and technical oversight/support for electrical design and site works associated with Power Generation under the Senior Electrical Engineer’s directions.
Maintain key relationships with Equipment Manufacturers, Service Providers and Industry Groups associated with Power Generation Equipment
Work within and support the Technical Authority Framework compliance as a Subject Management Expert
Review, justify and communicate recommendations for equipment selection, installation, operation and maintenance
Work collaboratively across relevant business areas in the development of commercial strategies and modes of operation to deliver design and performance improvements (for example, provision of ancillary services)
Reviewing and analysing SCADA data to assess the performance of operating power generating facilities.
Contribution to the development, review and ongoing support of asset management strategies and processes to ensure fleet equipment meets their intended design life at the lowest sustainable life-cycle costs
Under the guidance of the Senior Electrical Engineer, develop procedures and technical documentation regarding safe, reliable, and efficient operations and maintenance of power Generation equipment
Work closely with the asset digital team to develop performance analytics and monitoring strategies including predictive analytics
Develop professional relationships and effectively work with personnel across departments in an integrated organisation in performance of duties
Ensure health and safety, and environmental performance meets or exceeds company and regulatory requirements.
Ensure risk management plans are regularly reviewed and management actions are delivered; an
Address risk management as part of all material decisions taken.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Degree qualified or equivalent tertiary qualifications in Electrical engineering or related discipline.
Relevant work experience in similar roles in power generation and distribution.
Knowledge in the maintenance of HV Equipment, electrical, electronic, and instrumental equipment commonly installed in Power Stations.
Electrical engineering experience with low and high voltage equipment
Experience with CMMS Pronto platforms is well regarded.
Safety focus for people and equipment
Experience in Asset Management through Asset Management Procedures and Programs
Computer proficiency in MS Office suite.
Sound planning, analytical and critical thinking skills.
Initiative-taking with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
